manifest.author: AIBAST
manifest.description: Scans agreements for risk and drafts renegotiation briefs from a live simulated Dynamics 365 tenant, with an offline demo fallback.
manifest.name: @aibast-agents-library/contract_risk_review

contract_id.description: Contract identifier, such as CTR-5001; selects all implementation-package records for that contract.

operation.description: Operation to run; defaults to risk_scan when omitted.

record_id.description: Evidence amendment record identifier for implementation_package, such as CRR-501.
